def test_coding_deep_pack_signoff_envelope_separate_from_candidate_pool() -> None:

    assert SIGNOFF.is_file()

    doc = _load(SIGNOFF)

    assert doc["schema"] == "compression_coding_deep_pack_promotion_signoff_envelope_v1"

    assert doc["track_a_active_untouched"] is True

    assert doc["send_gate"] == "HOLD"

    assert doc["separate_from_candidate_pool_signoff"] == CANDIDATE_POOL_SIGNOFF.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()

    assert "candidate_pool_on_headline_merge" in doc["forbidden_in_this_envelope"]

    if doc.get("mainline_pipeline_status") == "opt_in_active":
        assert doc.get("apply_command_after_signoff")
    else:
        assert doc["apply_command_after_signoff"] is None

    gates = doc["promotion_gates_at_apply"]

    assert gates["roundtrip_path"] == "template_catalog_wire_v1"

    assert gates["exact_restore_pass_count_observed"] == gates["exact_restore_pass_count_min"]

def test_dual_pin_sweep_with_conservative_fallback() -> None:
    active_before = json.loads(ACTIVE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [PY, "scripts/run_compression_dual_pin_004_009_mini_sweep_v1.py", "--test-cap", "0.50"],
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
        timeout=180,
    )
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
    result = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    sweep = json.loads(SWEEP_OUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert sweep.get("apply_active_forbidden") is True
    if int(sweep.get("green_combo_count") or 0) > 0:
        assert DUAL_PIN_CANDIDATE.is_file()
        cand = json.loads(DUAL_PIN_CANDIDATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        env = cand.get("promotion_candidate_envelope") or {}
        assert env.get("selected_variant_id") == sweep["recommended_variant"]["variant_id"]
        assert result.get("dual_pin_promotion_candidate")
    else:
        assert CONSERVATIVE.is_file()
        assert result.get("fallback_conservative")
    active_after = json.loads(ACTIVE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert active_after.get("compression_metrics") == active_before.get("compression_metrics")

def test_evaluate_report_case_overlay_improves_cmp2_009_jaccard() -> None:
    from scripts.report_multilens_performance_eval import evaluate_report

    raw = (
        "Fact-lock and codebook drift must stay aligned with docs, scripts, and CI "
        "without manual override."
    )
    doc = {
        "compression_cases": [{"id": "cmp2_009", "raw_text": raw, "compressed_text": "", "reconstructed_text": ""}],
        "fusion_answer_cases": [],
    }
    base = evaluate_report(
        doc,
        source_input="fixture",
        mode="experimental",
        strategy="A",
        intensity="extreme",
        use_domain_router=True,
    )
    overlay = evaluate_report(
        doc,
        source_input="fixture",
        mode="experimental",
        strategy="A",
        intensity="extreme",
        use_domain_router=True,
        case_must_keep_overlay={
            "cmp2_009": {
                "add_hard": ["fact-lock", "codebook"],
                "add_soft": ["drift", "docs", "scripts", "ci", "aligned"],
            }
        },
    )
    b_cases = (base.get("compression_metrics") or {}).get("cases") or []
    o_cases = (overlay.get("compression_metrics") or {}).get("cases") or []
    assert b_cases and o_cases
    b_j = float(b_cases[0]["reconstruction_fidelity_jaccard"])
    o_j = float(o_cases[0]["reconstruction_fidelity_jaccard"])
    assert o_j >= b_j
